name: check
what: One mechanical check: what it runs, on what, and what failing means. AIP-1 builds the crawl, the docs check and the pixel diff; brain's checks come from AIP-3.

trace.author: agent
trace.note: A check is written in the checkpoint that adds it.
trace.reflection: Every new one is checked against the ones of its type that hold and says what it supersedes or merges; it is revised in place, each revision an event in the trace.
